summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository, verified by reading only (no tests, mypy, or Black run, per instructions). Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod, which passes a single two-item tuple. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, with a Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) for the title control. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with one bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (return value always checked, output checked only when not legacy_windows), test_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only module, mocked set_title called once with "Hello, world!"). Nothing committed.
